title: DigiPrism
author: irpina
description: An effects pedal for the Digitone mk1's audio inputs: four modules, Color (DRIVE, WARMTH, FUZZ, WAIL, SWELL), Motion (DOUBLER, VIBRATO, PHASER, TREMOLO, PITCH), Ambience (ECHOES, TAPE, SPACE, SCATTER, REVERSE) and Grit (FILTER, COMP, LO-FI, GLITCH, STATIC), in any order, with TILT, RATE, TIME, MIX and four AMOUNTs on the encoders, their secondary controls, GESTURE (knob recordings), CAPTURE (a 30-second looper and sustainer), eight presets and MIDI CCs. DIGIPRISM in core-dn1's Mod Menu (hold a track key) opens its page; while it is open it owns the audio engine (the synths are muted) and processes the inputs, and NO gives both back. With SETUP's SOURCE on DIGITONE and core-dn1 3.4 it processes everything the Digitone plays instead, and stays on after NO. Needs core-dn1 3.2.
